# bhf

**Tag**: web

## 简介

A simple to use Rails-Engine-Gem that offers an admin interface for trusted user. Easy integratable and highly configurable and agnostic. Works with ActiveRecord and Mongoid.

## 官网

- 主页: http://antpaw.github.io/bhf
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/bhf/0.10.17
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/bhf
